about.title: About WEEMAP
about.intro: WEEMAP is a practical, local-first way to discover and plan Sinai — with the parts of the journey connected in one place.
about.whyText: Sinai is shaped by sea, desert, mountains and the communities living between them. Planning it well takes more than a list of places; it takes useful local context and clear choices.
about.platformText: We bring together stays, transportation, experiences and published guides so you can understand the journey before you book.
about.localText: Our focus stays specific to Sinai. We present the information that exists, keep optional sections honest, and leave out claims that have not been confirmed.
about.connectionText: A stay affects transport. Transport affects timing. Timing shapes which experiences fit. WEEMAP keeps those decisions connected and gives you a human contact when you need help.
about.tagline: We map Sinai. You live it.

policy.title: Policies for a clear booking journey
policy.subtitle: The specific terms that apply to a request are shown and confirmed before booking or payment.
policy.bookingText: Availability, selected services, pricing and the applicable payment schedule are confirmed before a booking is finalized.
policy.cancellationText: Detailed cancellation terms are shown before booking confirmation.
policy.refundsText: Any refund terms that apply are explained before payment and depend on the confirmed booking terms.
policy.dateChangesText: Date-change requests are reviewed against current availability and the terms confirmed for the booking.
policy.noShowText: Any no-show conditions are included in the terms presented before booking confirmation.
policy.accommodationText: Stay details, room selection and available inclusions are confirmed as part of the booking request.
policy.tripsText: Activity details and any operator-specific requirements are confirmed before the experience is booked.
policy.transportText: Routes, transport mode, dates and availability are confirmed before transportation is booked.
policy.operationsText: Weather, safety or operational conditions may require an itinerary or schedule review. WEEMAP will communicate confirmed changes when they occur.
policy.paymentsText: The amount, schedule and available payment method are shown before payment is requested.
policy.privacyText: Customer information is used to process requests, coordinate selected services and provide support.
policy.contactText: Use the current WEEMAP contact details shown on this website for questions about a request or confirmed booking.
